title: Tightness of Algebraic-Degree Bounds for Affine Layers
summary: Experiments find the algebraic-degree upper bound for arbitrary affine layers tight for the first three rounds but loose later; characterize exactly when it is tight.

formal_statement.body: Characterize when the upper bound on $\delta_r$ for arbitrary $B(x)$ is tight.

scope.domain: Algebraic-degree analysis of symmetric constructions with arbitrary affine layers.
parameters: B(x): arbitrary affine layer covered by the upper bound
r: round index of the algebraic-degree quantity δ_r
scope.unresolved_remainder: Characterize when the algebraic-degree upper bound is tight for arbitrary affine layers B(x).

citations.label: Coefficient Grouping for Complex Affine Layers

progress.summary: The source obtains the bound using relaxed constraints and reports experimental tightness for the first three rounds but looseness later, leaving a general tightness characterization open.
citation_labels: Fukang Liu et al., Coefficient Grouping for Complex Affine Layers
